turns.user_message: We're looking for something to do tonight
turns.agent_response:

If you're looking for something more upbeat later, Avalon Nightclub opens at 10:00 PM for dancing and DJs. After a late night, a session at Elemis Spa tomorrow morning is the best way to reset.

turns.user_message: The kids are with us too, ages 8 and 12
turns.agent_response:
I've got you — having the kids along makes for a completely different, high-energy kind of night. Since they're 8 and 12, Cyber Quest is going to be their favorite spot because it’s a massive arcade filled with the latest video games and attractions. 

For something more active, the Wombi Rock climbing wall is right near the arcade and is a blast for that age group to challenge themselves. If you and your partner want to catch that live music at the Wolf Den later, Kids Quest offers supervised entertainment for children up to age 12 so you can have a little adult time while they're having their own party. 

Do your kids usually go straight for the high-tech arcade games or would they rather try conquering the climbing wall first?

turns.user_message: Oh and my mother-in-law, she doesn't walk well
turns.agent_response:
I've got you — keeping her comfortable while the rest of the family explores is a priority. For guests with limited mobility, the Sky Tower is the best choice because it sits more centrally to the main resort attractions and dining areas. 

To minimize the distance she has to travel, I'd suggest using our valet parking so she can enter the lobby immediately upon arrival rather than walking from the parking garages. Our accessible rooms and suites are designed with wider entryways and grab bars to ensure her stay is a relaxing retreat rather than a challenge. If she prefers to relax while the kids are at the arcade, she can order from our 24-hour room service menu and enjoy the view from her room. Before the kids head to Cyber Quest, Todd English's Tuscany is located very close to the Sky Tower elevators and offers a beautiful, low-impact dining experience right by the indoor waterfall.

Does she usually prefer a room with a walk-in shower or would a soaking tub be better for her?
